svg.title: Progress: 79 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 274 of 343 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 69 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 0 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 51 of 66; Sketches and reference planes 24 of 28; Part (ordered modeling) 52 of 64; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 25 of 31; Sheet metal 21 of 29; Assemblies 30 of 47; Drawings 47 of 52; Program configuration 24 of 26.
